This plot is small, only about a quarter hectare, and I am growing beans and other legumes. Beans do not need much fertilizer because they fix their own nitrogen, so I will not waste my money on chemical fertilizer — I save that for my maize plot. I will put some manure from my animals on the field to help the soil, and I will plant seed I saved from last season because buying new seed every year is too expensive. My wife and children will help me weed and harvest, and I do not have money to hire labor for such a small plot.
